items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And later on he and I became very close friends. We became roommates on that band.

ctx.x: And later on he and I became very close friends. We became roommates on that band. And so, one Sunday we were in Nashville and I was humming a little thing that I used to always hum around Chicago. You know, we used to sneak out drinking in Chicago when I was with Earl. And liquor wasn't legal then, you know, back there then, you know.

So, this guy used to serve liquor in teacups. And we used to -- I used to always kid him about it. His name was Ike. So, I made up a little thing. (Sings) "The--taint what'cha do--way h'atcha do it" (unintelligible) and a little thing like -- we used to kid him. So, Sy heard me humming that one day and he said, let's make a song out of that. I said ok. So, one sunday in Nashville we weren't working, and he and I sat down -- there was a piano in the lady's house and we got fooling around with it. And that's when…
